d:
Shaggy, coarse charcoal grey fur acting as hair, covering a feral face. Fierce, glowing amber eyes with a wild expression. Apparent age is mature adulthood. A lean, athletic lupine build. Wears a tattered deep crimson sleeveless vest and dark brown trousers. Features a long, bushy charcoal grey tail, canine ears, and sharp claws on four fingers per hand.
BODY COLOR: charcoal grey
